description: Playable versions for old-archive MOVIE titles, built from the live old archive parts (alireza-spec/FN download-data). Each play_url is the direct download file URL itself (the old archive has no playit tokens). Split by old archive part (1-3). Series are NOT in this index — their old links are folder URLs, not files.
groups: SoftSub = hardsub files; Dubbed = dubbed; NoSub = no subtitle. Sizes come from the archive's own size text after each link (e.g. '2.71 GB'); missing sizes are '' and are filled by the site's lazy client-side probe.
lookup: Find the part via the old download-index.json (IMDb -> part 1-3) or play-index-old-titles.json (normalized title[|year] -> {part, key}), then fetch play-index-old-part-<part>.json. Used ONLY as a fallback when the new-archive play-index has no joined play data for the title.
name: Family Night play index (old archive / Donyaye Serial, movies only)
